import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    l = len(s)
    c = 0
    i = 0
    while i < l - 1:
        current = s[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < l and s[j] == current:
            j += 1
        z = j - i
        if z % 2 == 0:
            c += 1
        i = j
    print(c)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
